plugin.name: Mr Agent
plugin.description: AI chat assistant for CPN. MCP is the panel-wide tool protocol; Mr Agent skills cover Help/Menu, Websites, Packages, and stub areas (Email, DNS, PHP, Plugins, Accounts). Provider API keys optional for free help.
plugin.keywords: ai, mcp, skills, assistant, openai, anthropic, chatbot, model context protocol
plugin.author: master3395

features.feature: In-site chat UI with provider and model picker
OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and custom base URL providers
Free lightweight CPN help and menu search without a paid key
Panel-wide MCP tool surface with per-area skills under skills/
Active skills: Help/Menu, Providers, Websites list, Packages list
Stub skills: Email, DNS, PHP, Plugins, Accounts
Owner ACL: admins only, all users, or package id list

plugin.uninstall_impact: Chat app under the site plugins folder is removed
Secrets under /var/lib/cpn/mr-agent/<domain>/ remain until cleaned manually
